sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a selectboard of three members at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): publishes NO East Haven roster ('Contact the Town Clerk'). The town's official website names no current selectboard members, so the seats are left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kerri Fillion as Town Clerk of East Haven. The town's website advertises the clerk's position as opening for hire in the first quarter of 2027; Fillion is the holder of record in the Secretary of State's January 2026 Guide.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kerri Fillion as Town Treasurer of East Haven; the same first-quarter-2027 hire notice applies.
